title: Reading Human Preference from Looped Transformer Internal States
abstract: arXiv:2604.09870v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Show a frozen language model two replies to the same request, one of which a person preferred. Can a small probe on the model's hidden states tell which? On Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, a model that runs its layers four times per token, and Anthropic's HH-RLHF data, the answer is yes, but only faintly. A linear probe picks the preferred reply 61.5% of the time, a small nonlinear network that scores each reply separately 64.9%, and the evaluator trained for version 1 reaches 64.7% on the test split: clearly better than simple rules such as picking the longer reply, but weak. Whether preference is stored as a comparison between the two replies or as a property of each is still open. A linear probe cannot tell, and a network that reads both replies together has an estimated edge of only 0.7 points (95% CI 0.0 to 1.4) over one that scores each reply separately. translated_title: 从循环Transformer内部状态中读取人类偏好
translated_abstract: 向一个冻结的语言模型展示对同一请求的两个回复，其中一个为人类所偏好。在模型隐层状态上放置一个小型探针能否分辨出是哪一个？在Ouro-2.6B-Thinking（一个对每个token将其层循环运行四次的模型）和Anthropic的HH-RLHF数据上，答案是肯定的，但效果微弱。线性探针有61.5%的概率选中被偏好的回复，一个分别对每个回复评分的小型非线性网络达到64.9%的准确率，而为版本1训练的评估器在测试集上达到64.7%：这明显优于诸如“选择更长回复”之类的简单规则，但整体仍然较弱。人类偏好究竟是以两个回复之间的比较形式存储，还是作为每个回复各自的属性存储，这一问题仍未解决。线性探针无法区分这两种假设，而一个同时读取两个回复的网络相对于分别对每个回复评分的网络，其估计优势仅为0.7个百分点（95%置信区间为0.0到1.4）。这些结果在三项控制条件下保持稳定：以两种顺序对每一对回复进行评分、划分……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，通过在循环Transformer模型的内部状态上训练小型探针，可以以约61%-65%的微弱优势识别人类偏好的回复，且证据表明偏好信息更可能以单个回复的属性而非两回复之间的比较形式编码于模型内部。
en_tdlr: Small probes on a looped transformer's internal states can weakly identify human-preferred responses (61.5-64.9% accuracy), suggesting preference is encoded more as a property of each reply than as a comparison between replies.
